text:
maya: Heads-up — BrightHealth says their usage CSV for Mar 10-15 has blank/empty rows for part of the file and their invoice shows ~2,305,800 tokens but the dashboard shows ~2,102,388. They provided the export filename usage-2026-03-10_2026-03-15-shard-3.csv and called out job id 98321. Can eng/ops confirm whether backfill/reprocess for job 98321 ran and if shard 3 completed? cc @rachel-finance

len: Looking now. Do we have the job status from exporter? I remember a couple of partial-shard failures last week.

ops-bot: Export job 98321 -> worker-7 -> FAILED writing to s3 (EIO) at 2026-03-16T02:14:08Z. Retries=2, shard=3. Decision: auto-requeue=false.

jordan: Log snippet from exporter-7 around the failure:

```
ERROR 2026-03-16T02:14:08Z Exporter job=98321 shard=3 write_s3 failed: EIO: write failed (s3://exports/usage-2026-03-10_2026-03-15-shard-3.csv)
Caused by: underlying i/o error -> WriteError: short write
Retries attempted: 2
```

len: That explains the blank rows — shard 3 never fully uploaded, so downstream join produced empty section in the combined CSV and aggregator used only successful shards for dashboard counts. I'll manually requeue a reprocess for shard 3. Any constraints (retention/TTL) we should be aware of?

maya: Please reprocess ASAP. Customer says invoice was generated already and they're worried about being billed incorrectly. CCing @rachel-finance to advise on billing policy if counts change.

rachel-finance: If the reprocess changes billed tokens by >1% or more than $500, we'll need a formal billing adjustment. When you reprocess, add a `bill_adj=true` flag so finance gets the delta report.

len: On it. Command I'll run: `kubectl exec -it exporter-7 -n prod -- /bin/sh -c "exporter --job 98321 --shard 3 --reprocess --bill_adj"` — kicking off now, expecting ~10-20m. I'll post stdout/errors.

support-bot: BrightHealth attached a sample of the CSV showing 12 consecutive empty rows around timestamp 2026-03-13T04:00:00Z. They're asking for ETA on a corrected file.

len: Reprocess finished — success. New file uploaded: s3://exports/usage-2026-03-10_2026-03-15-shard-3.csv (new checksum). Reprocessed shard added +203,412 tokens compared to the partial/failed upload.

jordan: Ran reconciliation between rebuilt export and invoice: dashboard rebuilt total = 2,305,620 tokens; invoice earlier recorded 2,305,800 tokens; difference = 180 tokens (invoice higher). Previously dashboard showed 2,102,388 because shard 3 was missing. With the reprocessed shard included, numbers match to within 0.01% (good).

rachel-finance: Delta is 180 tokens (invoice > rebuilt). That's within rounding tolerance; we will not issue a billing credit. I'll mark this as reviewed and keep notes on the invoice for audit. If customer still disputes, escalate with the CSV + reconciliation report.

maya: I'll send the corrected CSV to BrightHealth and include the reconciliation summary from jordan, plus the ops log showing reprocess success. I'll mark the ticket pending-customer-confirmation then resolve once they ack. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
